name: ScrollStack-TS-TW
title: Scroll Stack Cards
description: A stack of full-width cards that pin near the top of the viewport as you scroll, each new card sliding up and shrinking the ones behind into a tidy pile.
use: You want several feature or step cards to reveal one by one as the visitor scrolls, instead of a static grid.
avoid: It takes over scrolling with a smooth-scroll library and needs a tall container with large bottom padding.
a11y: Scroll-linked transforms ignore reduced-motion settings, and the inner scroll container has no label or focus styling. (keyboard: partial, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Wide charcoal cards with heavily rounded corners and a soft shadow, sitting on a near-black stage. Each card holds a small mono index in the top-left and a white heading above a dim subtitle. As they pile up, the cards behind show only as slightly darker, narrower strips along the top.
behaves: Scrolling pins the front card near the top and brings the next one up over it; each card below scales down so the pile forms narrow strips behind. A smooth-scrolling wrapper drives the motion, and nothing moves until the user scrolls.
customise: Cards go in as children; spacing, stack position, base scale, rotation, blur and container-versus-window scrolling are props. Card colours and size come from your own classes on each item.
weight: moderate: Only four card nodes, but the smooth-scroll library runs a requestAnimationFrame loop while mounted.
demo: Cards 01 to 04 titled Design, Build, Launch and Grow, each with a short line such as "Ship with confidence".
issues: Cards have a fixed 20rem height and 3rem padding, so long titles or small screens will clip content.
The scroll container is h-full, so it collapses to nothing if the demo wrapper has no set height.
polishWhy: Clean stacked layout and smooth pacing, but plain dark-on-dark cards with very dim subtitles.
